data.name: ScamwatchChat_Desc_Key
data.value: Chat with a SQL table in plain English. Calls a Text-to-SQL API that writes T-SQL, runs it and explains the result.

data.name: boundValue_Desc_Key
data.value: Any text field or value. The control doesn't read or change it; it's only needed to place the control.

data.name: apiBaseUrl_Desc_Key
data.value: Root URL of the Text-to-SQL API, e.g. https://scamwatch-sql-api.example.com

data.name: apiScope_Desc_Key
data.value: Entra ID scope for the API, e.g. api://<api-app-id>/Query.Run

data.name: clientId_Desc_Key
data.value: Application (client) ID of the single-page app registration used to sign in.

data.name: tenantId_Desc_Key
data.value: Directory (tenant) ID. Leave empty to allow any work account.

data.name: redirectUri_Desc_Key
data.value: Sign-in redirect URI. Must be on the same origin as the app. Defaults to the page's origin.

data.name: useMockApi_Desc_Key
data.value: Answer from built-in sample data instead of calling the API. For demos and testing.

data.name: allowConnectionChange_Desc_Key
data.value: Shows the SQL server, database, table, Azure OpenAI endpoint, API version and model deployment as an editable form with Connect in Settings, like the Streamlit app's Connection form. The values are sent to your API, which must check each one against an allowlist. Off: they're shown read-only.

data.name: title_Desc_Key
data.value: Heading shown at the top of the control.

data.name: placeholder_Desc_Key
data.value: Hint text in the question box.

data.name: exampleQuestions_Desc_Key
data.value: Starter questions, one per line. Shown before the first question.

data.name: showTableOverview_Desc_Key
data.value: Show the table's columns, sample rows and data dictionary above the chat.

data.name: defaultMaxAttempts_Desc_Key
data.value: Initial number of times (1-5) the model may rewrite a query that fails. Users can change it in Settings.

data.name: defaultPreviewRows_Desc_Key
data.value: Initial number of rows of each result (5-200) the model reads to write its answer. Only limits what is sent to the model; the full result always appears in the table. Users can change it in Settings.

data.name: allowFollowUps_Desc_Key
data.value: Initial setting for sending recent questions and answers with each new question.

data.name: historyTurns_Desc_Key
data.value: How many earlier question/answer pairs are sent for follow-up questions.

data.name: dataDictionary_Desc_Key
data.value: Plain-text description of the columns, codes and business rules, sent with every question. Users can upload their own instead.

data.name: dataDictionaryName_Desc_Key
data.value: Name shown for the data dictionary set above.

data.name: allowDictionaryUpload_Desc_Key
data.value: Let users upload their own .txt data dictionary. Turn off to always use the one set above.

data.name: lastAnswer_Desc_Key
data.value: The assistant's most recent answer text.

data.name: lastSql_Desc_Key
data.value: The SQL behind the most recent answer.

data.name: lastRowCount_Desc_Key
data.value: Rows returned for the most recent answer.

data.name: lastError_Desc_Key
data.value: Error from the most recent question, or empty.

data.name: activeDictionaryName_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the data dictionary sent with new questions, or empty.
